test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The height of five students, Aakriti, Kiran, Lisa, Manisha and Rekha, are compared. The height of Kiran is more than only two students. The height of Manisha is immediately greater than Rekha, and Rekha is immediately greater than Kiran. How many students are taller than Rekha?
solution:
Given: Five students, Aakriti, Kiran, Lisa, Manisha and Rekha. 

The height of Kiran is more than only two students. 

__ > __ > Kiran > __ > __

The height of Manisha is immediately greater than Rekha, and Rekha is immediately greater than Kiran. 

Manisha > Rekha > Kiran > Kiran/Lisa > Lisa/Kiran

So, there are only one students are taller than Rekha.

Hence, the correct answer is **"One"**.
